title: Dynamic MRI in the early detection of Frozen Shoulder
summary:
Frozen shoulder most likely is an inflammatory condition of the shoulderjoint associated with a characteristic course of disease with pain and limited mobility in the affected shoulder.

This study is designed to improve detection of disease specific changes in MRI using contrast enhanced sequences.
Further the course of disease will be monitored with additional clinical and MRI-examinations. This is ought to support an adequate treatment choice.

interventions.name:
Patients with clinical diagnosed Frozen Shoulder by medical history/clinical examination
Patients receive 3 MRIs in total and accompanying clinical examinations

Patients with different pathologies of the shoulder joint, i.e. shoulder impingement
Patients receive 3 MRIs in total and accompanying clinical examinations

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with pain and restriction of range of motion in the affected shoulder joint, suspicious of frozen shoulder.
Exclusion criteria:
Missing (capacity of) signed consent, known allergy to MRI contrast media, patients with high-grade renal impairment (GFR <30 ml/min), contraindications for MRI-examinations, particularly non MRI-conform implants, tattoos or piercings, pronounced claustrophobia, pregnancy
